mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Pauses selected functions on AllocationManager by setting bits in its pause bitmap. It can block allocation changes, operator set registration and deregistration, and slashing. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Sets every bit in the AllocationManager pause bitmap, blocking allocation changes, operator set registration and deregistration, and slashing at once. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Pauses selected functions on DelegationManager by setting bits in its pause bitmap. It can block new delegations and queuing or completing withdrawals. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Sets every bit in the DelegationManager pause bitmap, blocking new delegations and queuing or completing withdrawals at once. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Pauses selected functions on EigenPodManager by setting bits in its pause bitmap. It can block new EigenPods, credential and checkpoint proofs, withdrawal and consolidation requests, and withdrawals of restaked ETH. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Sets every bit in the EigenPodManager pause bitmap, blocking new EigenPods, credential and checkpoint proofs, withdrawal and consolidation requests, and withdrawals of restaked ETH at once. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: role-transfer-affects-fork-timestamp
mitigations.description: Hands the proofTimestampSetter role to a new address, which can then set the Pectra fork timestamp and stall proof validation for every native restaker. Owner is the Executor Multisig (1-of-2, signed by the 10-day Timelock and the 9-of-13 Community Multisig).

mitigations.label: fork-activation-control
mitigations.description: Sets the timestamp from which EigenPods use the Pectra proof format. A wrong value makes pods check proofs against the wrong format, so valid proofs can fail and native ETH withdrawals can stall. Only the proofTimestampSetter can call it, currently the Operations Multisig.

mitigations.label: ownership-transfer
mitigations.description: Hands ownership of EigenPodManager to a new address in one step, with no acceptance needed. The new owner gets every owner-only function on the contract at once. Owner is the Executor Multisig (1-of-2, signed by the 10-day Timelock and the 9-of-13 Community Multisig).

mitigations.label: ownership-renounce
mitigations.description: Sets the owner of EigenPodManager to the zero address for good. After that, every owner-only setting on the contract would be frozen in its current state. Owner is the Executor Multisig (1-of-2, signed by the 10-day Timelock and the 9-of-13 Community Multisig).

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Pauses selected functions on StrategyManager by setting bits in its pause bitmap. It can block deposits and the burning or redistribution of slashed shares. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Sets every bit in the StrategyManager pause bitmap, blocking deposits and the burning or redistribution of slashed shares at once. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: role-transfer
mitigations.description: Changes the strategyWhitelister, which is the StrategyFactory today. The whitelister decides which strategies accept deposits, so a malicious one could list a backdoored strategy for new deposits. Balances in existing strategies stay out of its reach. Owner is the Executor Multisig (1-of-2, signed by the 10-day Timelock and the 9-of-13 Community Multisig).

mitigations.label: ownership-transfer
mitigations.description: Hands ownership of StrategyManager to a new address in one step, with no acceptance needed. The new owner gets every owner-only function on the contract at once. Owner is the Executor Multisig (1-of-2, signed by the 10-day Timelock and the 9-of-13 Community Multisig).

mitigations.label: ownership-renounce
mitigations.description: Sets the owner of StrategyManager to the zero address for good. After that, every owner-only setting on the contract would be frozen in its current state. Owner is the Executor Multisig (1-of-2, signed by the 10-day Timelock and the 9-of-13 Community Multisig).

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Pauses selected functions on RewardsCoordinator by setting bits in its pause bitmap. It can block reward submissions, root submission and disabling, and claims. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Sets every bit in the RewardsCoordinator pause bitmap, blocking reward submissions, root submission and disabling, and claims at once. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: activation-delay-bound
mitigations.description: A submitted root becomes claimable after the activation delay, currently 7 days. Until then the rewards updater can disable a bad root with disableRoot. After activation, claims against the root can no longer be stopped this way.

mitigations.label: root-veto
mitigations.description: Disables a distribution root before it activates, so nobody can claim against it. Only the rewards updater can call it, and only while root submission is unpaused. It moves no funds.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Sets the delay between submitting a root and claims opening on it. Each root stores its activation time when it is submitted, so a change only affects later roots. The contract sets no upper or lower limit, so the owner could set the delay to zero and remove the review window for future roots.

mitigations.label: future-fee-redirect
mitigations.description: Sets the address that receives the protocol's share of rewards. The change applies to future rewards, and fees already paid out stay where they are. Owner is the Operations Multisig (3-of-6).

mitigations.label: role-transfer-rewards-control
mitigations.description: Sets the rewards updater, the single address that submits and disables distribution roots. A malicious updater could submit a root that pays rewards to its own addresses. Each root waits for the activation delay first, and in that window the owner can replace the updater so the new one disables the bad root.

mitigations.label: role-grant
mitigations.description: Adds or removes an address allowed to create rewards-for-all submissions. Submitters fund these from their own balance, so the role cannot take funds from the protocol.

mitigations.label: ownership-transfer
mitigations.description: Hands ownership of RewardsCoordinator to a new address in one step, with no acceptance needed. The new owner gets every owner-only function on the contract at once. Owner is the Operations Multisig (3-of-6).

mitigations.label: ownership-renounce
mitigations.description: Sets the owner of RewardsCoordinator to the zero address for good. After that, every owner-only setting on the contract would be frozen in its current state. Owner is the Operations Multisig (3-of-6).

mitigations.label: funded-by-caller
mitigations.description: Creates a rewards submission on behalf of an AVS. Only the EmissionsController can call it, and the EIGEN it distributes comes from the EmissionsController's own balance, so nothing is taken from restakers.

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Pauses selected functions on EmissionsController by setting bits in its pause bitmap. It can block EIGEN emission flows. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Sets every bit in the EmissionsController pause bitmap, blocking EIGEN emission flows at once. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: role-transfer-emissions-control
mitigations.description: Changes the Incentive Council, the only address that can add or update distributions. A malicious council could send future EIGEN emissions to its own recipients. Owner is the Operations Multisig (3-of-6).

mitigations.label: future-emissions-only
mitigations.description: Adds a distribution that starts in a future epoch. The council can send future EIGEN emissions to recipients it chooses, up to the configured per-epoch emission rate. Balances that already exist stay out of its reach.

mitigations.label: future-emissions-only
mitigations.description: Changes an existing distribution for future epochs, leaving past emissions as they were. The risk matches addDistribution.

mitigations.label: ownership-transfer
mitigations.description: Hands ownership of EmissionsController to a new address in one step, with no acceptance needed. The new owner gets every owner-only function on the contract at once. Owner is the Operations Multisig (3-of-6).

mitigations.label: ownership-renounce
mitigations.description: Sets the owner of EmissionsController to the zero address for good. After that, every owner-only setting on the contract would be frozen in its current state. Owner is the Operations Multisig (3-of-6).

mitigations.description: Sets every bit in the AVSDirectory pause bitmap, blocking operator registration and deregistration with AVSs at once. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: ownership-transfer

mitigations.label: ownership-renounce
mitigations.description: Sets the owner of AVSDirectory to the zero address for good. After that, every owner-only setting on the contract would be frozen in its current state. Owner is the Executor Multisig (1-of-2, signed by the 10-day Timelock and the 9-of-13 Community Multisig).

mitigations.label: pause-bound

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Sets every bit in the StrategyBaseTVLLimits pause bitmap, blocking deposits and withdrawals at once. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Pauses selected functions on EigenStrategy by setting bits in its pause bitmap. It can block deposits and withdrawals. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Sets every bit in the EigenStrategy pause bitmap, blocking deposits and withdrawals at once. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: pause-bound

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Sets every bit in the RegistryCoordinator pause bitmap, pausing all of its guarded functions at once. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Sets the address that approves operator churn, which is when a new operator replaces an existing one in a full quorum. A malicious approver could let bad operators push out honest ones. That affects EigenDA correctness, and no restaked funds move.

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Sets the ejector on the RegistryCoordinator, currently the EjectionManager. Like EjectionManager.setEjector, it manages EigenDA membership and moves no funds.

mitigations.label: ownership-transfer
mitigations.description: Hands ownership of RegistryCoordinator to a new address in one step, with no acceptance needed. The new owner gets every owner-only function on the contract at once. Owner is the EigenDA Operations Multisig (2-of-4).

mitigations.label: ownership-renounce
mitigations.description: Sets the owner of RegistryCoordinator to the zero address for good. After that, every owner-only setting on the contract would be frozen in its current state. Owner is the EigenDA Operations Multisig (2-of-4).

mitigations.label: pauser-registry-swap
mitigations.description: Points RegistryCoordinator at a different PauserRegistry. Whoever controls the new registry decides who can pause and unpause RegistryCoordinator. Only the unpauser of the current EigenDA PauserRegistry can call it, which is the Executor Multisig (1-of-2, signed by the 10-day Timelock and the 9-of-13 Community Multisig).

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Pauses selected functions on EigenDAServiceManager by setting bits in its pause bitmap. It can block batch confirmation. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: pause-bound
mitigations.description: Sets every bit in the EigenDAServiceManager pause bitmap, blocking batch confirmation at once. Pausers can only pause, and the Executor Multisig, as unpauser, restores operations.

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Sets the address that creates reward submissions for EigenDA. Submissions are paid from the initiator's own balance, so this role cannot take funds from the protocol.

mitigations.label: rewards-redirect
mitigations.description: Calls RewardsCoordinator.setClaimerFor for EigenDA as an AVS. The new claimer can collect the AVS's accrued rewards through processClaim until the owner changes it back. Owner is the EigenDA Operations Multisig (2-of-4).

mitigations.label: role-management
mitigations.description: Adds or removes an address allowed to call confirmBatch. A malicious confirmer could confirm incorrect data-availability batches. That harms EigenDA correctness, and no restaked funds move through it.

mitigations.label: future-only-validity-check
mitigations.description: Turns the rule that rejects batch signatures based on stale stake on or off. It changes data-availability checks only, and no funds move.

mitigations.description: Calls pauseAll on every contract listed in the registry, pausing the whole registered protocol in one transaction. The unpauser can restore operations.

mitigations.description: Grants a role on the ProtocolRegistry. Giving someone PAUSER_ROLE lets them call pauseAll and pause every registered EigenLayer contract in one transaction. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by the Executor Multisig (1-of-2, signed by the 10-day Timelock and the 9-of-13 Community Multisig).

mitigations.label: role-revoke
mitigations.description: Removes a role on the ProtocolRegistry, for example taking PAUSER_ROLE away from the Pauser Multisig. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by the Executor Multisig (1-of-2, signed by the 10-day Timelock and the 9-of-13 Community Multisig).

mitigations.label: future-only

mitigations.description: Moves the vault from its deposit phase into its allocation phase, which closes deposits and locks the stake for the configured duration. Only the vault admin can call it. Withdrawals open when the duration ends or when the arbitrator calls advanceToWithdrawals. The implementation contract itself holds no shares.

mitigations.label: rewards-redirect
